reviews.comment: Jonghoon Lee is a great professor! If I could, I would take more classes with him. He does a great job getting students involved in the class lectures and often times this leads to cordial debates. The class content is about what you would expect for Political Science but his teaching style is a fresh change of pace from the typical boring lectures

Professor Lee is such an amazing professor! The class is easy and straightforward. He grades participation once a week but is very lenient on absences. You're graded on a few summary papers and you get to pick what topics you write about. If you're looking for a POLS elective that is interesting and easy, take this class with Professor Lee!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was this professor's first class and he did amazing! There were 2 summary papers over articles we read and one final essay which he gave clear grading criteria. He is super helpful and easy to reach outside of class, and He definitely tried to make the lectures interesting. Take this professor if you want an easy, yet interesting POLS class.
